in_marathi.name: Kakoli
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of speech
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kakoli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kakoli is derived from the Sanskrit language and is the name of the goddess of speech, Vak or Saraswati. Kakoli is a revered name in Hinduism, representing the power of eloquence and wisdom.
